title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Earlier Rate Restored by a Late-Notice Credit
content:
**Billing history guidance — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The late-notice earlier rate — the rate a late-notice credit on a room-and-board charge restores — follows the agreement's billing history.

1. Where the agreement carries room-and-board charges posted for the charge's tier with the prior-rate notice-hold charge basis, the earlier rate is the daily rate of the one of those whose span begins latest.
2. Where it carries no such charge and the agreement's admission date is on or after 1 July 2026, the effective date of the current schedule, the earlier rate is the current schedule's daily rate for the agreement's own tier, there being no earlier rate to restore.
3. In every other case, the earlier rate is the preceding schedule's daily rate for the agreement's own tier.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).**
- Notice-hold charges on file for a tier other than the charge's tier only: case 1 does not apply.
- No notice-hold charge; admission on 1 July 2026: case 2. Admission on 30 June 2026: case 3.
